text: あなたが　ほんきを　だした　ところを　ほかの　みんなにも　みせてやってよ！

structure.jp: あなたが　ほんきを　だした　ところを
structure.en: what you're like when you get serious

structure.jp: ほかの　みんなにも

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あなたが　ほんきを　だした　ところ
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb can sit right before a thing to describe it. あなたが　ほんきを　だした　ところ = 'the sight of you having gotten serious'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb says you do it for someone, in a casual tone. みせてやって = 'show it to them'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb at the end is a casual request, with the polite ください left off. みせてやってよ = 'please show them!'.
